handoffs.summary:
Applied Aegean sun across landing and workspace via shared palette and typography tokens; preserved PublicEntry behavior; 288 frontend tests, TypeScript, production build, desktop/mobile browser checks, and API/SPA/Labs endpoint probes passed.
Sandbox: 1-lab23-aegean; commit: 55b91cd

Contrast refinement in commit 0d58de5: preserved the Aegean palette and backgrounds while restoring white foregrounds on ink, brand, and violet filled controls and dark Aegean text on translucent chips. Browser checks measured 13.32:1 for itinerary choice buttons, 12.82:1 for Beta, and 4.41:1 for the brand action. PublicEntry 7/7 tests, full frontend 288/288 tests, TypeScript, production build, CSS diagnostics, and API/SPA/Labs endpoint checks passed.

Final Lab 23 review: added permanent /welcome access, complete representative beta pricing with no missing-rate placeholders, improved text contrast, and standardized the AI Tripplanner Beta route-icon lockup. Focused public-entry and workspace tests, TypeScript, production build, and live API/SPA/Labs checks passed. Sandbox: 1-lab23-aegean; commit: 56ceb02

Promotion validation follow-up: corrected case-sensitive TRIPPLANNER_HOME isolation and restored atomic Lab store backups. Focused recorder and usage tests passed under the promotion validator PYTHONPATH. Sandbox: 1-lab23-aegean; commit: 928cbe3
